headline: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 at lower prices
quote: they’re available at a lower price: $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens.
claim: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 on 9 Nov 2026. Both generate output up to 30% faster than the 5.1 models and cost $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens.
why_it_matters: The top Claude model is cheaper per token, which matters if you pay for API calls in your own agent or coding projects.
title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 \ Anthropic

headline: Anthropic restricts Mythos 5.2 to vetted cyber and life-science organisations
quote: Claude Fable and Claude Mythos are the same underlying model. Fable has strong cybersecurity and biology safeguards
claim: Anthropic says Fable and Mythos are the same underlying model. Fable carries cyber and biology safeguards and is open to all users, while Mythos access goes through the Cyber and Life Sciences Verification Programs.
why_it_matters: Students cannot use Mythos directly; Fable is the version you can build on, with safeguards that may block some security-research prompts.
title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 \ Anthropic

headline: Anthropic adds Fable 5.2 fast mode at $16 and $80 per million tokens
quote: Fast mode is available for $16 per million input tokens and $80 per million output tokens.
claim: Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 have an optional fast mode that speeds up token generation by up to 2.5 times, priced at $16 per million input tokens and $80 per million output tokens.
why_it_matters: Fast mode doubles the standard price, so it only pays off for latency-sensitive tools, not for batch jobs or hobby projects.
title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 \ Anthropic
